title: Unitarity and the On-Shell Action of Worldline Quantum Field Theory
abstract: Develops the on-shell action formalism within WQFT for scattering of spinning compact bodies in GR in the post-Minkowskian expansion. Constructs real on-shell action from vacuum diagrams with causal (retarded) propagators. Demonstrates generalised unitarity techniques adapted to WQFT for multi-loop contributions. Establishes concrete link between WQFT and amplitude-based methods via unitarity cuts.
key_claims: Generalised unitarity techniques work in WQFT for multi-loop calculations
Unitarity cuts establish equivalence between on-shell action and amplitude methods
Extended to 3PM order with quartic spin interactions
Includes dissipative terms in the full on-shell action
